# GitHub Copilot instructions — 3DCodeVerse Lab

This repository is a shared 3D model and scene workshop. Before designing, pulling, or pushing scene/map assets, read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/SCENE_HUB.md`. Use `scripts/scene_hub.py` and per-scene JSON manifests in `scenes/catalog/`.

Only publish an authorized, reviewed scene from a separate feature branch, never directly to main. Record provenance, licenses, SHA-256 and validation status. Never pretend to have run Blender, HY-World inference, or real WebGL rendering if it was not executed. The HY-World 2.0 bridge remains in draft PR #20 until it is merged.
